Title: Sales Agent logs in with valid credentials
Preconditions: Account Active with a role of Sales Agent
Steps: 1. POST `login` with email + password + device_type + device_token
Expected result: HTTP 200; `status` "1"; `message` "You have successfully logged-in."; `data.token` a JWT; `data.role` Sales Agent; `subscription_status` active

Title: Wrong password is rejected without leaking whether the account exists
Test data: `.local` role "Sales Agent" + a literal wrong password
Steps: 1. POST `login` with the real email and a wrong password
Expected result: HTTP 200; `status` "0"; `message` "Please provide valid login details."; `data` `[]`; no token anywhere in the body

Title: Unknown account gets the same message as a wrong password
Steps: 1. POST `login` with an address that does not exist
Expected result: HTTP 200; `status` "0"; `message` identical to TC-F01-002 — no account enumeration

Title: Missing password is rejected by validation

Business Sales Agent logs in and is always treated as in free trial
Preconditions: BSA account Active under a Manager
Steps: 1. POST `login` with email + password + device_type + device_token
Expected result: HTTP 200; `status` "1"; `data.role` Business Sales Agent; `free_trial_status` **true** (forced for BSA in AuthController); a JWT is issued

Title: Business Agent (Manager) cannot log in to the mobile API
Steps: 1. POST `login` with the Manager email + password
Expected result: HTTP 200; `status` "0"; `message` "You are not authorized to login. Kindly contact administrator."; no token

Title: Admin is blocked on the mobile API (BT-1 target behaviour)
Steps: 1. POST `login` with Admin email + password + device_type + device_token (as the app sends them)
Expected result: HTTP 200; `status` "0" and no token — Admin refused. **Today the API admits Admin and issues a token** (runtime 2026-09-16), so this is a known gap until BT-1 is built

Title: A login without a device token fails cleanly, not with an SQL error
Expected result: A handled failure (HTTP 200 `status` "0", or 4xx) with no SQL text. **Today: HTTP 500 with the `usertoken` insert SQL** (validation does not require `device_token`)
